scope: Stu round 3 and pure rollout on five Azure boxes; conditional process-pool memory guidance for bf16 users; label and budget research on Azure6 and Azure2.
disposition: This collector does not run bf16 nets or Stu's fork-free research runtime. No worker recycling, pure rollout, training, model/source adoption, host/peer commands or local settings change. Maintain immutable Gen8 main mix, three normal workers and zero BEN; inspect local resources independently.
training_exclusions_for_future_cohorts: Any future new owned cohort still needs complete pinned training-family membership for all released models, including subsequent Stu nets, and all prior corpus safeguards. Do not rewrite this existing v4.1 union, manifest or audit.
